# License Coverage regression fixtures

These fixtures are immutable companion records for the License Coverage v1 and
Upstream Release Binding v1 contracts. They preserve the exact artifact,
release, source archive, license-file and provenance hashes supplied by the
QICR without committing wheel binaries or customer data.

The SentencePiece fixtures demonstrate the stronger Linux SLSA binding and the
Windows official-release exact-byte binding with an absent SLSA subject. The
PyInstaller hooks fixture demonstrates generic component/path selectors and a
build-only usage binding. All fixture records are regression inputs, not
commercial license approvals.
